name: Greyson Clothiers
note: Detroit golf and lifestyle apparel brand founded in 2015 by founder and CEO Charlie Schaefer. Its February 2025 $20m Series A growth-capital round was led by NewBound Ventures and New Era CEO Chris Koch, with participation by Tom Nolan (Kendra Scott CEO) and David Chu (Nautica founder); Nolan, Chu and NewBound's Michael Hoffman joined its board (company release, 2025-02-07). Its full share register isn't public.
